mmq.text: Rushwood is the living forest of the Cho-Arrim, where a plague strikes their village, they blame Mercadia City, and war seems likely.
The Cho-Arrim bring Orim aboard the Weatherlight to Rushwood, treating the ship as the sign of the return of Ramos, and they repel a cateran attack that came to seize it.
Mercadian soldiers led by Gerrard Capashen attack the village and slaughter most of its inhabitants.
Realizing he is on the wrong side, Gerrard orders hostilities to stop and kills his own troops.
